title: District 8 Early Voting Resumes Today After Thanksgiving Pause; 577 Ballots Cast So Far
excerpt: Early voting in the Laredo City Council District 8 special election resumes today, Saturday, Nov. 28, after a Thanksgiving pause, with 577 ballots cast in the first three days.
content:
Early voting in the special election to fill the Laredo City Council District 8 vacancy resumes today, Saturday, Nov. 28, after a pause for Thanksgiving and Black Friday.

Voters cast 577 ballots during the first three days of early voting, according to the Webb County Elections Administration. That included 257 on Monday, 178 on Tuesday, and 142 on Wednesday — 134 in person and eight by mail.

Early voting will continue through Tuesday, Dec. 1. Election Day for the District 8 special election is Saturday, Dec. 5.

What is at stake

The special election fills the District 8 seat on the Laredo City Council. The seat has been vacant, and the winner will serve the remainder of the term.

The District 8 race is on the same December ballot as the mayoral runoff. Webb Watch 956 previously published a December elections guide covering both races.

Turnout so far is modest: 577 ballots in three days in a district-wide race. Whether the Thanksgiving break slows momentum or the final days bring a surge will be clear when the county releases updated totals.
